title: Generator Matching: Generative modeling with arbitrary Markov processes
tldr_zh: 用 Markov 生成元统一 FM/diffusion/离散 diffusion，R^d 上生成元=flow+diffusion+jump 完全刻画，Bregman 散度是唯一合法损失；jump+flow 叠加 CIFAR-10 FID 2.36
tldr_en: Unifies FM, diffusion and discrete diffusion via Markov generators; fully characterizes R^d generators as flow+diffusion+jump; Bregman divergences are the only valid losses; jump+flow superposition reaches CIFAR-10 FID 2.36.
key_numbers: CIFAR-10 / ImageNet-32 FID: Flow (Euler) 2.94 / 4.58; Jump (Euler) 4.23 / 7.66; Jump+Flow superposition (Euler) 2.49 / 3.47; Flow (2nd order) 2.48 / 3.59; Jump+Flow (mixed) 2.36 / 3.33 (Table 2)
Protein multimodal Diversity/Novelty: MultiFlow 0.38/0.39 -> + SO(3) jumps 0.48/0.41; unimodal 0.52 -> 0.63 without retraining (Table 3)
R^d generator = flow + diffusion + jump is exhaustive under regularity assumptions (Theorem 1, Eq. 9)
GM and conditional GM losses share gradients iff the loss is a Bregman divergence (Proposition 2, Appendix C.3)
Cond-OT path N(tz,(1-t)^2) admits a jump-process solution of the KFE (Example 1, Eq. 13)
